title: Persistent synthetic Invitations sandbox respects Ops roles, exact approval, revision conflicts and STOP across campaigns
steps: Start the owned tracy-invitations-owned-pg stand per tasks/invitations-sandbox-testing.md; never use the shared dev/customer database.
Build harness and run apps/tracy-web/scripts/invitations-local.mjs. Sign in at localhost:51810 as sandbox-owner@invitations.test using local OTP.
Create campaign, use sample CSV, preview and commit, generate draft, edit/save/approve one snapshot, run sandbox, simulate inbound/reply, then STOP. Refresh and verify persisted records.
expect: Tests exit 0 with no failure or skip; cross-origin writes and revoked/nonstaff seats are refused.
Real email domains including reserved-prefix .test.com are rejected before persistence; imported first names become synthetic.
Preview commits bind actor, digest, revision and TTL. Replay is idempotent; concurrent stale writes are refused.
Editing invalidates approval. Simulation persists the exact approved snapshot without external network/mail calls.
STOP and prior attempts block linked identities across campaigns. Developer sees aggregate counts only.
Campaign/messages/audit persist after refresh; integrations remain not connected and production cannot enable sandbox.
fence: Real PostgreSQL transactions and real Ops session/admission. Sandbox provider behavior only; does not validate Gmail/OAuth, live eligibility or customer sending.
